name: Maou-Sama
source:
This is the story of a young man who actually wanted a very typical life - to live his life,
along with his father, stepmother, half-sister, and step-ante.

But one day, the young MC learns of several problems that plague his father and stepmother. There begins the cycle that no one can stop.

Because his stepmother is pursuing a plan, an unknown woman has approached her about the
"God's" child is to bear to save the world, as it will probably be destroyed in time.

So she tried everything to fulfill the prophecy...but unfortunately, it is not that easy.

When our MC accidentally overhears a conversation, he learns that his father has a little problem
and can't seem to get that wish...

Who needs an old man when there's someone in the family who can also take care of...could be a witness?

And so your adventure begins. Will you be able to grant your stepmother this wish? Who is this unknown woman, and will the world really be destroyed?

Take the role of the MC and reveal the secrets of your family, solve problems, and meet new people again and again - fulfill the prophecy or do what you want.

What could possibly happen?
translation:
这是一个年轻人的故事，他实际上想要一种非常典型的生活——过他的生活，
以及他的父亲、继母、同父异母的妹妹和继母。

但有一天，年轻的主持人得知了困扰他父亲和继母的几个问题。这就开始了无人能阻止的循环。

由于他的继母正在执行一项计划，一名身份不明的女子向她询问了此事
“上帝”的孩子要承担拯救世界的责任，因为随着时间的推移，世界可能会被毁灭。

于是她想尽一切办法去实现预言……但遗憾的是，事情并没有那么容易。

当我们的MC无意中听到谈话时，他得知他的父亲有一点问题
而且似乎无法实现这个愿望…

当家里有人可以照顾……可以成为证人时，谁还需要一个老人呢？

于是你的冒险就开始了。你能实现你继母的这个愿望吗？这个未知的女人到底是谁，世界真的会毁灭吗？

扮演MC的角色，揭露你家庭的秘密，解决问题，并一次又一次结识新朋友——实现预言或做你想做的事。

可能发生什么？
